jobs.title: Security Officer Part Time Unarmed Patrol Assessment
jobs.description:
About the position

As a Security Officer Part Time Unarmed Patrol Assessment in Richmond, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Tech/Media/Telecom, and more. Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Part-Time Security Officer, you can build a schedule that works for you and explore new roles using our Claim a Shift platform. As an Unarmed Patrol Officer supporting a dynamic technology, media, and telecommunications location, you will conduct routine patrols, maintain a visible presence to help deter incidents, and provide outstanding customer service. You will communicate clearly with employees and visitors while responding to security-related concerns. Join Allied Universal, where an agile, reliable, innovative team puts people first, delivers through teamwork, and acts with integrity.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer service to employees, visitors, contractors, and delivery personnel at a technology-focused location by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and emergency response activities as appropriate.
  • Respond to incidents, access concerns, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, escalating matters according to established protocols.
  • Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols of interior areas, exterior grounds, parking areas, and perimeter access points to help deter unauthorized activity and identify security-related concerns.
  • Monitor access points and verify visitor, contractor, and delivery credentials in accordance with site requirements while maintaining accurate activity logs and incident documentation.
  • Communicate observed hazards, suspicious activity, and operational concerns to site leadership and Allied Universal management, collaborating with appropriate personnel during response activities.

Requirements

  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Benefits

  • Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
  • Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

jobs.title: Licensed Special Event Security Officer
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
Join our dynamic team as a Licensed Special Event Security Officer, where you will play a crucial role in ensuring the safety and security of our events. You will establish relationships with customers, local law enforcement, and fire departments while maintaining a high level of vigilance regarding your surroundings. Your professional demeanor and exceptional customer service will set the standard for security personnel.

Basic Functions:

  • Control entrances and manage pedestrian and vehicle traffic.
  • Conduct patrols of buildings and perimeters.
  • Provide escort for personnel and materials.
  • Inspect security measures and fire safety exposures.
  • Handle special assignments as needed.

Responsibilities:
Your day-to-day duties will vary based on departmental size and post assignments, and reasonable accommodations can be made for specific needs. General functions include:

  • Arriving on time and reporting for duty in full uniform.
  • Maintaining a professional appearance and greeting customers, visitors, and employees courteously.
  • Staying informed about all updates to post orders and information from customers and AFS.
  • Patrolling or maintaining assigned positions, promptly reporting suspicious activities and incidents.
  • Monitoring surveillance equipment as outlined in your post orders.
  • Understanding all emergency policies and procedures for effective response to incidents.
  • Completing Daily Activity Reports, Log Entries, and Incident Reports accurately.
  • Recommending safety and loss prevention improvements based on observations.
  • Being knowledgeable about life safety systems, fire alarms, CCTV systems, and ensuring their proper operation.
  • Ensuring compliance with training and standards set by AFS and relevant agencies.
  • Regularly communicating new security concerns or changes with the Security Supervisor.

Skills and Abilities:

  • A security officer must demonstrate honesty, alertness, and discipline in safeguarding property and safety.
  • Maintain constant vigilance and dedication to duty.
  • Exemplify strong customer service skills consistent with our mission.
  • Handle multiple priorities effectively with a results-oriented approach.
  • Collaborate within a team and follow guidance efficiently.
  • Work with a sense of urgency and purpose.
  • Possess strong oral and written communication skills.
This job description provides a general outline of expected duties and responsibilities but is not exhaustive of all tasks that may be assigned. The company reserves the right to modify this description at its discretion.
